profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Viasat Inc.
profile.summary: My interest in low-level computing and digital design started early on in life when I decided to take apart all of my consoles. I was fascinated at how small yet complex every component inside the console seemed at the time. From there I took interest in older gaming systems and the very clever algorithms early developers developed for getting the most out of relatively simple/limited hardware architectures. All of my previous work experiences have helped to build me into a much more versatile employee able to contribute to a variety of projects.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Restored production line by adapting legacy software to work on new Dell COTS servers.
•	Work with PL and Hardware Engineers to develop drivers and interfaces to interact with new products or re-spins of legacy products. This can include anything from creating test scripts in python to test the new features to developing the bare-metal interfaces to new hardware additions.
•	Developed new bare-metal software and interface to a new IF board for my team’s product (high-rate modems). Discovered and resolved multiple hardware, FPGA, and software issues brought on during the integration of the new IF board.
•	Created a new development cycle for my team to compile, test, and package our product and deliver it to the customer in the form of an RPM (Redhat package manager).
•	Proposed and implemented a new software architecture to restructure a legacy product and adapt it to the new data processing pipelines. This new architecture (developed in C++ (backend), and JavaScript (front)) has proven to improve readability and overall understanding of the legacy product.
positions.insights: Embedded Software, C (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: Engineering Student Tutor
positions.description: Tutor students in many different electrical and computer engineering courses. My main topics included computer systems (assembly and C programming), linear signals and systems, basic circuit analysis, calculus I, and physics I and II, and intermediate electromagnetics.

positions.title: CubeSat Research Program – EPS Embedded Software Lead
positions.description:
•	Reduced team’s work by salvaging, debugging, and customizing previously written (and non-functional) legacy C code base (~3000 lines of code) which expediated the configuration for one of the microcontrollers from 4 weeks down to just 1 week.
•	Developed 10+ Hardware Abstraction Layers for current sensors, battery management devices, temperature sensors, I2C communication, and JTAG interfaces which finalized the overall EPS architecture and gained approval from the project’s sponsors.
•	Discovered and fixed 4+ major design issues in the avionics JTAG and I2C interfaces which allowed the team to advance to final stage testing. 
•	Empowered team to advance 2 critical design phase reviews by writing ~1000 embedded firmware lines of code that tested and integrated 15+ printed circuit boards (PCBs) for the satellite’s power electronics.

positions.title: Engineering Intern at Dynetics
positions.description:
•	Doubled the number of realistic/threat-representative foreign radar models showcased by the Dynetics simulation software by reverse engineering open-source information and deriving 70+ requirements for new radar models.
•	Delivered 15-minute presentations to the analyst team on a weekly basis to showcase my work and receive feedback.
•	Backed up design decisions with Python and MATLAB simulations and with literature references which enhanced my coding skills.

positions.title: Controls and Automation Co-op
positions.description:
•	Created a plant instrumentation database (with 300+ entries) which reduced the team’s workload and the time required to lookup specific inventory information by ~50%.
•	Enhanced plant operators’ situational awareness by creating 20+ clear and concise data visualization graphics using HTML.
•	Developed 2 tools in Python and Excel for automating documentation which allowed my peers to solely focus on exceeding the clients’ requirements after a major project setback.

honors.title: Thomas D. and Marianne M. Stringfellow Endowed Scholarship

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Auburn University Robotic Mining Competition Team
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Empowered mechanical senior design team to achieve full autonomy with their senior design project by integrating, integrating, and testing 2 LiDARs for their obstacle avoidance and path-finding systems (both systems developed using Java and C++ and interface through USB and RS-232)
•	Managed and collaborated with 5 senior design members tasked with building the robot’s control system and instrumentation layout.

company.name: Auburn University Robotic Mining Competition Team

volunteerExperiences.description:
EDay Volunteer – Auburn, Alabama
Bus Crew – Volunteer (April 2016)
•	Politely greeted campers and clearly communicated important information with all guests
•	Answered any questions in a concise and clear manner 
•	Engaged in casual conversation with some of the guests to assure their comfort during the bus ride.
